pdf-lib.min.js in this folder is pdf-lib 1.17.1 (npm pdf-lib 1.17.1, dist/), unchanged (https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib).
Same bytes as cdnjs ajax/libs/pdf-lib/1.17.1, checked against cdnjs's SRI hash and the npm package on 2026-11-10:
  pdf-lib.min.js  sha256 0f9a5cad07941f0826586c94e089d89b918c46e5c17cf2d5a3c6f666e3bc694f
SlimIO serves it itself so a tool never breaks when a CDN is slow or blocked; it builds PDFs in the visitor's browser.
The notices of the code bundled into the build (tslib, pako and others) are kept in the file's own /*! */ comments.
